Privacy

Collect less. Restrict access. Delete on time.

Registration information is stored in TechCommons-controlled Google Forms and is restricted to authorised team members. Information is collected only for administering the relevant program.

Operational privacy standard · Responsible adult approval required before public enrolment

Information collected

A community-class expression of interest asks for the student’s name, school, school year, parent or guardian name and contact details, previous coding experience and an optional practical-adjustment description. Publicity choices are separate and optional.

Organisation and general enquiries collect contact and contextual information needed to understand and reply. TechCommons does not ask for detailed diagnoses through these forms.

Purpose

Information is used to respond to enquiries, assess course suitability, communicate program arrangements, administer the relevant activity and meet safety responsibilities. It is not shared externally as a general practice.

Storage and security controls

Google Forms and response data are owned through a TechCommons-controlled account. Access is restricted to authorised people. Operational controls include two-factor authentication, unique passwords, no password sharing, no public response spreadsheets and no unnecessary downloaded exports.

Access is reviewed periodically and removed when it is no longer required. No online system can be represented as completely secure.

Retention and deletion

Registration data is retained for no longer than 12 months after the relevant course ends, unless an incident or legal requirement justifies longer retention.

Deletion covers form responses, spreadsheets, downloaded exports, email attachments and cloud Trash. Access lists are reviewed as part of program close-out.

Parent and guardian rights

A parent or guardian can ask what information TechCommons holds about their family, request a correction, withdraw future publicity consent or request deletion where the information is no longer required for program administration, safety or another applicable obligation.

External services

Google Forms may be used for final registration. The website currently prepares enquiry emails in the visitor’s own email application. Google Maps is not loaded on the community-class page until the visitor chooses to load it; a directions link is also available.

External services process information under their own terms and privacy practices. Families will be told which registration service applies before enrolment.

Privacy contact

Email techcommons.org@gmail.com with “Privacy request” in the subject. This shared account is owned and monitored by TechCommons.
